name: Gray Area Grand Theater
notes: Historic theater with full Grand Theater (800 max, 450 seated) or Half Theater rental (4,000 sq ft, 400 max, 250 seated, includes stage, lobby and bar). Rates are not published; 501(c)3 groups can apply to a Community Partnership Rental Program with discounted fees.

name: Gray Area Classroom
notes: Small 250 sq ft classroom with an 85 inch screen and small sound system, suited to meetings and workshops up to 30. Pricing on request via the venue rental form.

name: SPUR Urban Center
price_raw: Rentals start at $20,000 for up to 12 hours of service. Additional hours may be contracted; during citywide events a 3-day minimum applies and rates are subject to change.
notes: Three floors for up to 425 guests with exclusive use of floors 1, 2 and 4, house AV, guest WiFi and Herman Miller chairs included. No in-house AV tech or catering kitchen; caterers from the preferred list and licensed alcohol vendors only.

name: Koret Auditorium, SF Main Library
notes: 212-seat auditorium at the Main Library used for talks and screenings. Community use rules require an SF-based group of 6 or more, bookings up to 3 months ahead, and no promotion of products for commercial gain; fees not stated on the pages read.

name: YBCA Forum
operator: Yerba Buena Center for the Arts
price_raw: Forum Standard Access: $11,000 per day; Forum Premium Access: $14,000 per day. Standard building access 8:00am to 11:00pm.
notes: 6,700 sq ft flexible hall listed at 400 theater seating, 300 seated banquet and 500 standing. YBCA offers reduced fees to 501(c)3 organizations with documentation.

name: YBCA Lounge
operator: Yerba Buena Center for the Arts
price_raw: Lounge: $750 per day. The Lounge is free for artists, community partner groups, and nonprofit organizations.
notes: Smaller lounge space at YBCA, capacity not published. Free for artists, community partners and nonprofits, which may suit salons or small gatherings.

name: Salesforce Park Central Lawn
price_raw: $6,500 flat rate for a 5-hour rental (2-hour event, 2 hours setup, 1 hour breakdown), plus $1,000 per hour beyond the base period. Effective starting July 2026. $500 discount per event for eligible California 501(c)(3) nonprofits.
notes: Rooftop park lawn for up to 150. price_per_day holds the 5-hour flat rate and price_per_hour the supplemental rate; alcohol must be served through Barebottle Brewing and proposals are due 21 days ahead.

name: Salesforce Park Wetlands Garden
price_raw: $4,500 flat rate for a 5-hour rental, plus $500 per hour beyond the base period. Effective starting July 2026. $500 discount per event for eligible California 501(c)(3) nonprofits.
notes: Smaller rooftop garden rental for up to 50, good for an outdoor reception. price_per_day holds the 5-hour flat rate; payment by wire at least one week before.

name: Digital Jungle SF, Main Stage
price_raw: from $800 hire fee per hour; minimum booking 3 hours; cleaning fee $80; security $80/hour; prices include sales tax
notes: Main stage room on Mission St steps from Frontier Tower, up to 300 standing or 250 theater. Outside catering and BYO alcohol allowed; open 6am to midnight.

name: Trellis, Main Hall
price_raw: Weekdays from $1500 to $10000 min. spend per session, from $10000 min. spend per day; weekends from $1500 to $15000 per session, from $15000 per day. Minimum spend per session is for 4 hours of hire and 50 pax. A/V package $75 per event; livestream $150 per event.
notes: Hall in a coworking space near Frontier Tower; weekday availability is 6pm to midnight only. The listing contradicts itself on catering, so confirm food policy with the venue.

name: Sentro Filipino Event Space
price_raw: Weekdays 8:00 am to 4:00 pm: from $375 hire fee per hour; weekdays 4:00 pm to 11:00 pm and weekends: from $700 hire fee per hour; minimum booking 3 hours
notes: Cultural center hall for up to 225 theater style, with a 180 inch monitor and 250+ chairs. Outside catering allowed but no alcohol, provided or BYO.

name: Dogpatch Studios, 1st Floor
price_raw: from $5000 hire fee; the mentioned price is for 10 hours of hire; available 7:00 am to 10:30 pm
notes: Industrial event floor for up to 400 standing or 330 theater. Approved caterers only, no ticketed events, guests out by 10:30pm and a $4M liability COI required.

name: The Historic Klamath, Klamath Conference Center
price_raw: 7:00 am to 5:00 pm from $850 hire fee per hour; 5:00 pm to 11:00 pm from $1500 per hour; full day from $5900 hire fee per day; Full-Day Meeting Package (min. 45 guests) $6400 total; cleaning fee $250; minimum booking 5 hours
notes: 2,400 sq ft light-filled conference room with wireless mics, podium and a private outdoor deck on the waterfront. The listing says no in-house or external catering and no alcohol, so confirm food arrangements directly.

name: 25 Lusk, Private Dining Room
price_raw: from $3250 minimum spend per session (10:00 am to 11:00 pm, closed Saturday); minimum spend is food and beverage only and excludes a 22% Event Management Fee and 6% SF employer mandate charge
notes: Private dining room for seated dinners up to 35 with a projector. In-house American menu only.

name: Soma Restaurant & Bar, Entire Venue
price_raw: Full Buyout: $3000 Minimum Spend. Semi Buyout: $1500 Minimum Spend. 18% gratuity applies for parties of 6+.
notes: Restaurant buyout a few blocks from Frontier Tower for up to 120. Good for casual mixers; alcohol licence until 10pm.

name: Modi, Jungle Room
price_raw: Monday to Saturday: afternoon (11:30 am to 4:00 pm) from $5000 min. spend; evening (6:00 pm to 10:00 pm) from $10000 min. spend; closed Sunday
notes: Italian restaurant private room for up to 70 seated or 100 standing. Evening minimum is double the afternoon minimum.

name: Movida, Rumi Room
price_raw: from $800 hire fee + min. spend; from $2000 minimum spend per session (11:00 am to 11:00 pm)
notes: Small private room for founder dinners of up to 16 seated. Not wheelchair accessible per the listing.

name: Southern Exposure
price_raw: from $330 hire fee per hour; 4 hr. minimum
notes: Nonprofit art space with an industrial gallery for up to 150 standing. External catering and BYO alcohol allowed.

name: The Women's Building, Auditorium
price_raw: $279 per hour, 3 hour minimum; Monday to Friday reservations only between 9 am and 5 pm; ask about discounts for nonprofits
notes: 2,700 sq ft hall for 220 theater or 200 banquet, weekdays 9 to 5 only. Wine and beer allowed but no hard alcohol, and a sound technician is required for the PA.

name: The Women's Building, Audre Lorde Room
price_raw: $165 per hour; Monday to Friday reservations only between 9 am and 5 pm
notes: 1,500 sq ft daylit room for 70 conference style, includes 8 tables and 65 chairs. Good for daytime workshops.

name: The Women's Building, Room A
price_raw: $50 per hour; weekdays before 5 pm
notes: Small 446 sq ft room for 40 theater or 24 classroom. Cheapest workshop option found.

name: Minnesota Street Project Atrium
notes: 4,600 sq ft gallery atrium for up to 400 with bleacher seating and roll-up door; a private lounge is also available. Renters bring their own AV; pricing via inquiry form.

name: Creative SOMA Loft, Full Building
price_raw: $375/hr, 4 hr minimum
notes: 3,550 sq ft loft for up to 50 with kitchen and dedicated garage; host sells breakfast, lunch or happy hour add-ons at $25 per person. Exact address shared after booking.

name: Creative Landing Spaces SoMa Loft
price_raw: $88 to $103 per hour depending on guest count, layout and use type; 2 hour minimum; 75 inch TV add-on $40 flat
notes: Offsite and workshop loft for up to 45 with breakout rooms, projector and whiteboards, bookable 6am to 11:30pm. Very cheap for daytime workshops.

name: Decentered Studio
price_raw: $160 to $210/hr, 2 hour minimum
notes: Bright 1,700 sq ft nonprofit-run studio with full PA, mics and kitchenette; amplified sound allowed until 11pm. The listing says 150 people but describes seating for 60.

name: SHACK15
address: 1 Ferry Building, Suite 201, San Francisco, CA 94111
notes: Members club in the Ferry Building with bay views that hosts talks, LP meetings, private dinners and live podcasts. Capacity and pricing are not published; inquire via the private events form.

name: Mindspace Market Street Event Space
notes: Coworking event space on Market Street near Moscone with Wi-Fi, AV and support. Priced per event on request; street address not shown on the page read.

name: Heron Arts
notes: Converted early-1900s brick firehouse gallery in western SoMa that is occasionally available for private rentals. Capacity and pricing by email only.

name: UCSF Mission Bay Conference Center, Robertson Auditorium
notes: Auditorium with built-in stage and retractable seating that can split into three meeting rooms, next to the UCSF biotech cluster. UCSF's own rate and nonprofit pages returned 403 so pricing is left null; request a quote from UCSF Conference Services.

name: Exploratorium
notes: Science museum on the waterfront with rentable spaces from the Kanbar Forum (200 seated, 250 standing) and Fisher Bay Observatory (150 seated) up to the full facility. Pricing on request; about a 30 minute walk from Frontier Tower.

name: The Commonwealth Club of California
notes: Rentable spaces include the Taube Family Auditorium, multipurpose meeting room, boardrooms, library and a rooftop terrace with Bay Bridge views. Capacities and pricing not published on pages read.

name: Charmaine's Rooftop, San Francisco Proper Hotel
address: 1100 Market Street (entrance at 45 McAllister St), San Francisco, CA 94102
notes: 3,500 sq ft indoor-outdoor rooftop lounge one block from Frontier Tower; the hotel has 7,500 sq ft of event space including an 880 sq ft conference room and a 300 sq ft private dining room. Capacity and pricing on request.

name: The Pearl
notes: Multilevel Dogpatch venue: main floor 300 seated or 500 standing, plus mezzanine, a 220-person rooftop and the School Night room (50 seated, 100 standing). Full catering kitchen and in-house bar program; pricing on request.

name: Terra Gallery & Event Venue
notes: Two-level gallery venue; upper Terra level holds 400 seated or 725 standing and lower Mer level 300 seated or 725 standing, 24,000 sq ft combined. Pricing on request.

name: City View at Metreon
notes: Divisible skyline-view event floor with rooms from the Lobby (200 seated) to Embarcadero (850 seated) plus an outdoor terrace (120 standing). Large demo day option; pricing on request.

name: Frontier Tower event floors
price_raw: Citizenship starts at $190/month (or $150/month billed annually); membership includes free event space & movement floor
notes: Haus's own building: membership gives access to conference rooms and event spaces across 16 floors, including the Spaceship on F2. No public rate card for outside event rental was found.

name: Club Parlaey, Meetings & Events Space
price_raw: from $100 hire fee per hour; minimum booking 4 hours; cleaning fee $200; prices include sales tax
notes: Room for 30 theater or 28 classroom, open 24 hours. Outside food and BYO alcohol allowed.

name: UnderDogs Cantina, Main Room
price_raw: from $150 hire fee per hour (6:00 pm to 10:00 pm); per evening from $18 per person
notes: Sports bar near Oracle Park for parties of up to 300 standing. In-house food and drink only.

name: White Swan Inn, Conference Room
price_raw: from $150 hire fee per hour; minimum booking 4 hours
notes: Boutique inn meeting room for up to 20 theater or 12 boardroom with projector and whiteboard. Not wheelchair accessible per the listing, and catering rules conflict on the page.

name: Hotel Abri, City Room
price_raw: from $100 hire fee per hour; minimum booking 3 hours; typically for 10-15 guests and costs about $300
notes: Small boardroom for 14 near Powell Station, good for founder roundtables. No projector or screen listed.

name: Bruno's
price_raw: Sunday to Thursday: Rock-It Room from $1700 minimum spend; Gilded Room from $3000 min. spend; Full Venue from $7500 min. spend. Friday and Saturday: Rock-It Room from $2500 min. spend; Gilded Room from $2000 hire fee + min. spend; Full Venue from $3000 hire fee + min. spend.
notes: Live music bar with the Gilded Room (99 standing), Rock-It Room (65) or full buyout (165), good for parties. Outside caterers from an approved list; bar can run hosted, tickets or tabs.

name: Galleria Boheme
price_raw: from $295 hire fee per hour; minimum booking 3 hours; 10:00 am to 2:00 am
notes: Art salon and speakeasy for up to 49, suited to salons and intimate dinners. Bookable until 2am; in-house food and drink only.
